title: Audience and handling guidance
description: Advisory audience, sensitivity, and handling labels for review and least-disclosure projections. These fields do not grant access.

fields.label: Intended audience
fields.description: One or more audience labels that guide human review and recipient projections.

fields.label: Sensitivity
fields.description: An authored handling label. Studio recognizes public, internal, confidential, and restricted for projection planning while preserving every other value.

fields.label: Handling notes
fields.description: Short human guidance shown during reading, context review, staged review, and projection planning.
examples: Review before sharing outside the team.
